goal: Implement S1 of docs/specs/review-settlement-hardening.spec.md: every blocked Review submission result on the Claude Host carries one same-Host recovery action, and the Loop contract and reviewer definition stop steering the Parent into unrecoverable reviewer dispatches.

acceptance.assertion: Per S1 of docs/specs/review-settlement-hardening.spec.md (BR-REQ-1, BR-REQ-3): every blocked result returned by submitClaudeReview carries a non-empty recovery_action naming one same-Host next call, for each host observation failure (reservation not observed, incomplete terminal event order, correlation mismatch, receipt already consumed, launch envelope naming a different agent, unreadable transcript, transcript without a reviewer result), for each of the three reservation errors (second native tool call, duplicate PostToolUse, duplicate SubagentStop), and for a parent verdict that differs from the reviewer receipt. A released reservation directs to advance_assurance followed by a fresh reviewer dispatch; a retained reservation directs to resubmitting after the reviewer finishes. The duplicate SubagentStop reason states that a reviewer cannot be continued and a fresh reviewer must be dispatched. No recovery_action names another Host, a worktree, repair_authority_state, a commit, or unmanaged implementation. Existing reason strings other than the duplicate SubagentStop reason, release decisions, verdict_invalid handling, and non-blocked results are unchanged; the new field is optional on the shared result type and other Hosts are unaffected. The generated Claude bundle matches the runtime source.

Per S1 of docs/specs/review-settlement-hardening.spec.md (BR-REQ-2, BR-REQ-3): the packaged Loop contract no longer states that internal Agent envelopes run in the foreground on every Host; it states that the envelope is passed through unchanged, that on the Claude Host an Agent call always returns an asynchronous launch receipt which is normal and never a configuration fault, and that the Parent waits for the reviewer to finish before submit_review. The Loop contract and the reviewer agent definition both state that a dispatched reviewer is never continued or re-prompted (including through SendMessage), that the reserved prompt is dispatched verbatim, and that a blocked submit_review is recovered only through its returned recovery_action. Contract tests assert the presence of each statement and the absence of the retired sentence.
